# Герои

Компьютерная версия настольной игры «Герои» (Hobby World) с ИИ-игроками.
Правила — `docs/RULES.md`, карта — `docs/MAP.md`, план разработки — `docs/PLAN.md`,
все возможности запуска в терминале — `docs/CLI.md`.

## Запуск

Партию создаёт хозяин в терминале; там же идут движок, боты и Claude. Люди — и сам хозяин — играют в браузере
на телефоне, планшете или компьютере: страницу раздаёт игра хозяина, устанавливать ничего не нужно.

```
python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install pytest   # один раз
.venv/bin/python -m heroes                               # мастер: число игроков, кто играет на каждом месте и т. д.
.venv/bin/python -m heroes --players human,bot,bot       # без мастера: человек против двух случайных ботов
.venv/bin/python -m heroes --players human,bot --names Аня,Бот --password сова
.venv/bin/python -m heroes --players human,bot,bot --factions orcs,nagas,random --first random
.venv/bin/python -m heroes --players human,claude,claude   # человек против двух Claude (Opus 5.5)
.venv/bin/python -m heroes --players claude,claude --show-thoughts   # Claude против Claude
.venv/bin/python -m heroes --players claude,claude --watch           # то же, а смотреть — в браузере
.venv/bin/python -m heroes --players human,claude --model claude-haiku-5-5 --effort low   # дёшево, для отладки
.venv/bin/python -m heroes --load saves/round05_auto_2026-10-17_19-45-02.json   # продолжить сохранённую
.venv/bin/python -m heroes --continue                    # продолжить самую свежую
.venv/bin/python -m heroes --profiles                    # только страница «Профили и статистика»
.venv/bin/pytest -q                                      # тесты
```

Хозяин увидит ссылку для каждого человека — с его именем и паролем, например
`http://192.168.1.5:7777/?name=Аня&password=сова`: её открывают в браузере (свою — и сам хозяин), и партия
начинается, когда все сели за стол. Мастер спрашивает всё то же, что флаги: число игроков, кто на каждом месте
(человек, Claude, случайный бот), имена, фракции, модель и effort Claude, печатать ли замыслы Claude, порт и пароль,
кто ходит первым.

## Фракции

Все шесть фракций первой коробки: люди (`humans`), нежить (`undead`), гномы (`dwarves`), орки (`orcs`),
эльфы (`elves`), наги (`nagas`). Фракцию каждого места выбирает хозяин партии — в мастере или флагом
`--factions`, в том числе за людей. Каждой фракцией играет только один игрок, как в коробке; «случайная»
(`random`, по умолчанию) — из тех, что никто не выбрал.

Особые механики фракций — ярость орков и Дом вождей, наука гномов, проклятия нежити, Лавка бронника эльфов,
краки, ноты и гидра наг — играются у всех: в браузере на каждое особое решение своя форма, Claude получает
их описание и схему ответа, случайный бот пользуется ими наугад.

Терминал хозяина, сетевой протокол и протокол Claude — на английском (по-русски только оригинальные названия
игры: регионы, здания, войска). Страница в браузере — по-русски.
Сохранения лежат в `saves/`, в имени — номер раунда, дата и время: `round05_2026-10-17_19-45-02.json`.
Автосохранение делается в начале каждого раунда (`round05_auto_….json`; хранятся все — можно вернуться к любому раунду).
Сохранить посреди раунда, не прерывая партию, — команда `save` (или `save <файл>`) и Enter в терминале хозяина;
Ctrl+C сохраняет партию как `…_interrupted.json` и останавливает её у всех.

Claude-игроки работают через установленный Claude Code CLI (`claude -p`). Партия Opus — около $3–4
и 10–15 минут на каждого Claude-игрока. Тайные решения (перемещение, заявка войск в сражении) все Claude
принимают одновременно; перемещение наги и её гидры — одним вопросом, а модификацию войск Лавкой бронника
эльф называет вместе с заявкой. Диалоги с Claude — в `logs/claude/`, замыслы Claude печатаются в терминале хозяина флагом `--show-thoughts` (по умолчанию — только в партиях без человека).

В крупных решениях Claude получает свой планшет и сводку по соперникам. Полный планшет любого игрока
(здания с ценами и свойствами, артефакты, цены найма, линия чудовищ, стоимость перемещения) он может
запросить в любом вопросе полем `view_boards` — тогда получает планшеты и тот же вопрос ещё раз
(каждый планшет — один раз за решение). Тайные ответы соперников на планшетах не видны: они попадают
в состояние партии, только когда ответили все.

### Как Claude учится

Опыт ведётся отдельно для каждого варианта Claude — модели и уровня усилий (`--effort`):
`strategy/<модель>/<effort>/` (`default` — без `--effort`). Папка `strategy/` — рабочая копия ветки `strategy`
этого же репозитория (git worktree): коммиты Claude-игроков идут в неё, а не в `master`. Игра сама
подключает папку при первом разборе партии (`git worktree add strategy strategy`), пушить —
`git push origin strategy`. Устройство описано в `strategy/README.md`.

- **Заметки по фракциям** (`<фракция>.md`): разделы «General strategy», «Reminders» и «Against <фракция>».
  Файл своей фракции Claude получает в системном промпте. После партии он может, но не обязан, переписать
  общий раздел, напоминания и разделы против соперников, с которыми играл (против случайного бота — нет).
  Длина ограничена: общий раздел — 2000 символов, против фракции — 800.
- **Напоминания** — строки `- [<когда>] <текст>`, не больше 12. «Когда» — через запятую: `always`,
  `round N`, `rounds N-M` и виды решений (`build_recruit`, `destination`…). Подходящие напоминания движок
  вставляет прямо в вопрос. Claude правит их после партии, чтобы они срабатывали в нужный момент.
- **План и разбор.** Перед первым решением Claude продумывает план против выпавших фракций (`game_plan`),
  после партии разбирает свою игру (`game_review`). План виден в журнале, только если показываются
  замыслы; разбор показывается всегда.
- **История.** Каждое изменение заметок и скриптов — коммит: тема — объяснение Claude, тело — итог партии
  и разбор. Перед правкой Claude видит три последних изменения своего файла (с диффами) и скриптов.
- **Результаты** — `strategy/results.csv`: по строке на каждого Claude-иг

RaunakDune/Galatea-web-deploy.readme:
# lunarsim.org

Website for **LunarSim / Galatea** (visual place recognition on the Moon) and the game **Where on the Moon?**

- `site/` — the static website (no build step)
  - `index.html` home · `play/` the game · `sunlab/` Sun Lab · `research/` method and results
  - `data/trials.json` — 3,150 game rounds built from the LunarSim-VPR test set
  - `data/img/` — the test images (WebP) · `data/sunlab*` — Sun Lab renders and model ranks
  - `data/config.json` — game settings; **research data collection is off** (`"collect": false`)
- `functions/api/log.js` — Cloudflare Pages Function that stores anonymous game answers in D1 (only used when collection is switched on)
- `schema.sql` — D1 table for those answers
- `tools/` — scripts that regenerate the game data from the research repository

Research code, paper and benchmark: <https://github.com/RaunakDune/galatea-lunar-vpr>

## Deploy on Cloudflare Pages (one-time setup)

1. Cloudflare dashboard → **Workers & Pages** → **Create** → **Pages** → **Connect to Git** → choose `RaunakDune/Galatea-web-deploy`.
2. Build settings: Framework preset **None**, Build command *(leave empty)*, Build output directory **`site`**. Save and deploy.
3. In the new project → **Custom domains** → **Set up a custom domain** → `lunarsim.org` (and optionally `www.lunarsim.org`).
   Because the domain is on Cloudflare, the DNS records are created for you.

Every push to `main` then redeploys the site automatically; other branches get preview URLs.

## Switching on research data collection (only after ethics approval)

The game can log anonymous answers (images shown, choice, response time, a random per-visit ID; no names, emails,
IP addresses or cookies) for research on how people and AI recognise places on the Moon. Using these data in
publications is human-subjects research, so get approval (or an exemption) from your institution's IRB first.

1. Create the database: `npx wrangler d1 create lunarsim-answers`, then `npx wrangler d1 execute lunarsim-answers --remote --file=schema.sql`.
2. Pages project → **Settings** → **Bindings** → add a **D1 database** binding named **`DB`** pointing to `lunarsim-answers`. Redeploy.
3. Set `"collect": true` in `site/data/config.json` (edit the consent text if your IRB requires different wording) and push.
4. Export data: `npx wrangler d1 export lunarsim-answers --remote --output=answers.sql` (or query with `wrangler d1 execute`).

Players see an opt-in checkbox (unticked by default); nothing is sent unless they tick it.

## Regenerating the game data

```bash
# from a checkout of galatea-lunar-vpr with extracted features (see its docs/REPRODUCE.md)
python tools/build_trials.py DATA_DIR FEATS_DIR path/to/ft1e-4_netvlad_s0/desc_test.pt site/data --images
cd galatea-lunar-vpr/src && python ../../Galatea-web-deploy/tools/build_sunlab.py ../../Galatea-web-deploy/site/data
```

Each round shows a query image, the correct map image and five distractors chosen by geometry only (other places
more than 25 m away with a similar heading). "Rover AI" is the paper's best global model (fine-tuned NetVLAD head,
seed 0); "Earth AI" is zero-shot DINOv2-SALAD. Both picks are among the same six images the player sees.

## License

MIT (code and LunarSim renders). Apollo photographs on the research page: NASA, public domain.

# Block Blueprint

Design Minecraft builds in 3D on your PC (or phone), then build them in your world with the **Build Blueprint** mod:
see-through ghost blocks, a materials list, layer-by-layer building, block swapping and copying builds from your world.
Works on **Minecraft Java 1.17 to 26.3** with Fabric, plus Forge and NeoForge.

## Download
- **Windows app:** go to [Releases](https://github.com/CosmicLogic0/block-blueprint/releases/latest) and download
  `Block-Blueprint-Setup-x.y.z.exe`. The app updates itself when a new version comes out.
  Windows may say "Windows protected your PC" the first time - click **More info -> Run anyway** (the app isn't code-signed).
- **Minecraft mod:** on CurseForge: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/build-blueprint
  (Fabric needs Fabric API; Forge and NeoForge need nothing else).

## In Minecraft (default keys, change them in Options > Controls > Key Binds)
| Key | What it does |
|---|---|
| Page Up | Menu: saved builds, materials, settings |
| Arrow keys | Move the blueprint (Shift = 5 blocks, Ctrl + Up/Down = up/down) |
| Page Down | Turn it 90 degrees |
| Delete | Place it (then build layer by layer) / unlock |
| Home / End | Layer up / down |
| Insert | Copy a build from your world (press again to save) |
| Middle-click a ghost | Hold that block |

## Making a release (for the maintainer)
Raise the version in `package.json` and push: GitHub Actions builds the app installer and puts it on the Releases page.
To also publish the mod, list the versions in `.github/curseforge-upload.txt` in the same push (only new versions or real changes -
CurseForge rejects unchanged re-uploads) and set `mod-version.txt` to the new mod version (the mod uses it for its update notice).

## License
All Rights Reserved - see LICENSE. You can use the official downloads; please do not re-upload or copy the code.

## Run from source
Install Node.js, then `npm install` and `npm start` (or double-click `start.bat`).
The mod is in `fabric-mod/` (`build-mod.bat`, or `gradlew build`).

KeithThurlow/pilgrim-mechanica-2.readme:
# Pilgrim Mechanica 2

A mech salvage game in the browser: a convoy village rolling across endless dunes, salvage runs against its range,
swarms closing in. Three.js (WebGPU), TypeScript, Vite.

## Run it

```
npm install
npm run dev
```

The dev server opens the lab hub. Each lab is one system with live sliders:

- **Walker lab**: the procedural walker on streamed dunes. WASD to walk, Shift to sprint, click the ground to walk
  there. Auto walk wanders until you take over.
- **Terrain lab**: the dune field streaming around a moving marker.

Tuning is saved per lab in your browser; **Copy values** gives JSON to paste back as new defaults.

## Checks

- `npm test`: headless walker and terrain checks.
- `npm run build && npm run shots`: screenshots of every lab into `shots/` (first time: `npx playwright install chromium`).

Working rules and project layout: `CLAUDE.md`. The game: `docs/design.md`.

stratanen/stratoshivibes-blocks.readme:
# StratoshiVibes Blockspace

Neon block puzzle for the Solana Seeker. Drag pieces onto an 8×8 board, clear rows and columns, and every clear reveals part of a picture. Free to play, no ads. Connecting a wallet is optional (it unlocks Vol.1 Degens holder pictures), and an optional Shop sells in-game extras for SKR, SOL or USDC. No tokens or real-money rewards.

- Play in the browser: https://blockspace.stratoshivibes.com/
- Privacy policy: https://blockspace.stratoshivibes.com/privacy.html
- Terms of use: https://blockspace.stratoshivibes.com/terms.html

## One-time setup

1. **Settings → Pages**: Source "Deploy from a branch", branch `main`, folder `/ (root)`, Save.
2. **Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions → New repository secret**: name `KEYSTORE_PASSWORD`, value the same password used for the Mahjong app. The app is signed with the same StratoshiVibes key (`release.keystore.enc`).

## Build the Android APK

The APK is a Solana Mobile web shell around the hosted game, built by GitHub Actions.

1. Actions → **Build Android APK** → Run workflow.
2. Raise **version_code** by 1 for every new release (1, 2, 3 …).
3. Download the APK from the finished run's Artifacts, or from the Releases page.

Every future update must be signed with this same key, so keep a backup of the keystore and its password outside GitHub.

## Add a reveal picture

1. Save the picture as a square image (1024×1024 or larger) in `art/`, e.g. `art/level-03.webp`.
2. Add its path to the `LEVELS` list at the top of the script in `index.html`.
3. Add the same path to the `CORE` list in `sw.js` and raise the cache name (`sv-blocks-v1` → `sv-blocks-v2`) so phones pick up the change.

Pictures play in the order of the list and start again after the last one.

## Change a tile

Tile images live in `tiles/` (square, 512×512 recommended). Replace a file with the same name, then raise the cache name in `sw.js`.

nrebolloso/homeclear.readme:
# Homeclear: a discharge dress rehearsal

Someone films the home with a phone before the patient is discharged. From that video we build a measured Gaussian
splat, find the floor, make occupancy and floor-bump maps, plan the patient's walker route, simulate hundreds of trips
with a learned step model, rank fixes, and write a report for the occupational therapist. See `SPEC.md` for the full product.

**Hard rule: every measurement comes from splat geometry, never from a generative model.** Generated images and fills are
tinted and labelled "imagined, not measured".

## Layout

```
stages/00_env.py ... 12_export_scene.py   one stage each: python stages/NN_x.py <config.yaml>
common.py                                 config, results/<stage>.json records, PLY I/O, floor RANSAC
run_all.sh                                whole pipeline from the laptop
configs/                                  one YAML per scene (home.yaml = the default)
slurm/                                    HiPerGator jobs (env build, SfM, splats, GLOMAP, motion model, renders, rug fill)
tools/table_scale.py                      scale from the tape-measured table, with width/height checks
motion/                                   learned next-footstep model (PhysioNet Multi-Gait-Posture), world-model tests
worldmodel/                               world model interface (INTERFACE.md) and Python rollout engine
cosmos/                                   Cosmos Transfer 2.5 controls, jobs, tinting
viewer/                                   walker game (Vite + TS + three.js + Spark); viewer/check.html = plain splat check
marker/make_marker.py                     ArUco scale marker
tests/                                    CPU self-checks on synthetic scenes with known answers
data/                                     footage links + data/measurements.yaml (gitignored)
proof/                                    evidence for every result: job IDs, logs, numbers, images
```

Outputs go to `out/<run_name>/`.

| Where | Stages |
|---|---|
| HiPerGator CPU job (`slurm/sfm.sbatch`, burst QOS) | 1 frames, 2 COLMAP poses |
| HiPerGator GPU job (`slurm/cluster.sbatch`, 1x B200) | 0 env, 3 splat, 4 scale, 5 floor, 6 occupancy |
| Laptop | 7 route planning, 8 hazards |
| HiPerGator GPU job (`slurm/render.sbatch`) | 9 hazard renders (gsplat has no CPU renderer) |
| Laptop | 10 viewer check, 11 report, 12 scene export |
| Laptop | 5c room shell, 12b fills (telea / ns), 14 re-scan diff |
| HiPerGator GPU jobs | 6c object proposals (`slurm/detect.sbatch`), 12b `--backends lama`, Cosmos Reason (`cosmos/slurm/cosmos_reason.sbatch`), Cosmos clips (`cosmos/prerender.py --submit`) |

More stages, all optional, each writing next to the others in `out/<run>/`:

| Stage | What | Output |
|---|---|---|
| `05c_shell.py` | walls (two perpendicular directions) + ceiling fitted to the splat; the Cosmos controls use it where the capture saw nothing | `shell.json` |
| `06c_detect.py` | Grounding DINO + SAM 2 masks voted onto the Gaussians and split into separate objects: proposals in config format; `game.objects: auto` makes them all movable | `objects_proposed.yaml`, `objects_points.npz` |
| `12b_fills.py` | the floor (and wall) each movable object hid, inpainted: median / telea / ns (CPU), lama (GPU); imagined, tinted | `objects/fill_<name>_<backend>.ply` |
| `14_rescan_diff.py before.yaml after.yaml` | film again after the fixes: 2-D ICP alignment, each hazard resolved / remaining, new bumps on the route | `verification.json` |
| `cosmos/reason.py` | Cosmos Reason 2 on capture frames along the route, proposals lifted to 3-D and checked against the grids | `reason.json` |
| `tools/contact_table.py` | the toe-contact table, calibrated to ~1 in 578 strides at 1 cm | rewrites `contact_table` in configs |
| `tools/score_proposals.py proposed.yaml --truth <config or labels>` | stage 6c scored against boxes a person drew: found / fragmented (a merge would fix it) / missed, kind, unmatched proposals | table + `-o score.json` |

## Versions

| Package | Version | Why |
|---|---|---|
| PyTorch | 2.14.1 + cu130 | the cu126 build has no sm_100 (B200) |
| CUDA toolkit (HPG module) | cuda/13.0.2, built with gcc/12.2.0 | matches the cu130 torch build for compiling gsplat |
| gsplat | git main @ 512d366 (reports 1.6.0) | the last PyPI release predates torch 2.14 |
| pycolmap | 4.2.1 (CPU wheel) | SfM on CPU; avoids mixing CUDA 12 and CUDA 13 runtimes |
| Viewer | see `viewer/package.json` | Spark (`@sparkjsdev/spark`) + three |

Stage 0 prints the versions it actually found, the GPU, and the driver, and checks that torch has kernels for that GPU.

## Laptop setup

Ubuntu/Mint or macOS with Python 3.12, ffmpeg, Google Chrome (headless checks), Node, and rsync.

```bash
python3.12 -m venv --system-site-packages .venv
.venv/bin/pip install .                               # dependencies from pyproject.toml
.venv/bin/python tests/test_synthetic.py --viewer     # should end with SYNTHETIC OK
tests/run_py.sh                                       # every Python self-check, synthetic scenes first
cd viewer && npm ci && npm test && node e2e/run.ts   # e2e: headless Chrome against the dev server
```

**Windows laptop** (Git Bash): `py -3.12 -m venv .venv`, `.venv/Scripts/python -m pip install numpy scipy opencv-python
pillow plyfile pyyaml matplotlib imageio-ffmpeg` (bundles ffmpeg). Scripts find `.venv/Scripts/python` themselves
(`hpg.sh`), the e2e checks find Chrome or Edge (`CHROME=` overrides), and ssh/rsync to HiPerGator run inside WSL Ubuntu,
where the ControlMaster lives (Windows OpenSSH has none). Per-person cluster paths go in a gitignored
`cluster.local.yaml` (`cluster: {ssh, base, repo, env}`); the scripts export `HPG_ROOT` from it.

All checks: `tests/run_py.sh` (every Python self-check, stops at the first failure), `cd viewer && npm test`,
and with `npx vite --port 5179` running, `node e2e/run.ts`.

## HiPerGator

**Connect.** Add a `Host hpg` entry (HostName hpg.rc.ufl.ed

ntgoten/pactblade.readme:
# Pactblade

A custom vocation for Dragon's Dogma 2: a pact-bound swordsman with a fast, magick-charged blade in one hand and
eldritch magick in the other. No shield. Inspired by the D&D 5e warlock (names only).

Pactblade is built on **Vocation & Skill Builder (VSB)** as a Fighter vocation and runs as a REFramework script.
Play it as Fighter, or as Warfarer with a sword. Version **1.1**.

**Download:** the zip from [Releases](../../releases) - it includes the effect / sound pak, which is not in the source here.

## Requirements

| What | Version | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Dragon's Dogma 2 (PC, Steam) | post-DLC update | Tested on the current build. |
| [REFramework](https://github.com/praydog/REFramework) | current | Runs the script and loads the effect pak. |
| [_DragonCore](https://www.nexusmods.com/dragonsdogma2/mods/1916) | 1.2.0 or newer (tested 1.2.5) | Pactblade's library. |
| [VocationAndSkillBuilder (VSB)](https://www.nexusmods.com/dragonsdogma2/mods/1917) | 1.4.0 or newer | The vocation and its 8 skills. |
| [_ScriptCore](https://www.nexusmods.com/dragonsdogma2/mods/30) | current | Ground checks (Dimension Door, Misty Strike landings). |

Recommended: [Fluffy Mod Manager](https://www.fluffyquack.com/) to install.

## Install

1. Install the requirements.
2. Add the zip to **Fluffy Mod Manager** and enable it. Or copy its `reframework` and `pak_mods` folders into the game
   folder, next to `DD2.exe`, merging folders.
3. Start the game. In the REFramework menu (Insert): **VocationAndSkillBuilder → Vocations → Fighter: pick Pactblade**.
4. Be a Fighter (or a Warfarer with a sword in hand). The skills are at the Vocation Guild.

Back up your saves before trying any new mod.

## Stats and passives

- **Magick damage x1.5:** the magick part of all your hits is multiplied by 1.5 (the physical part is unchanged).
- **The sword carries magick:** with a sword in hand, its Magick equals its Strength (shown on the status screen),
  and it carries full-strength **Thunder**. Back to normal when Pactblade isn't active.
- **Fast blade:** Onslaught 1.5x faster, every other attack 1.2x.
- **Core skills:** Thief's **Controlled Fall** and **Footpad** are on. Fighter's shield core skills are off.
- **No shield:** a shield can't be equipped while Pactblade is active; the shield actions are off.
- **No boons:** elemental boons (Fire / Ice / Thunder Boon) can't be put on you; the sword's Thunder replaces them.
- **Stat growth:** Fighter's.

## Always available (no skill slot)

| Ability | Input | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| Swift Step | tap the **vocation button** | Thief's dodge roll. |
| **Eldritch Bolt** | **hold** the vocation button, release | A charged magick bolt. **Binds** the target it hits. |
| **Eldritch Burst** | vocation button **during / right after a sword attack** | A point-blank blast. **Binds** the target. |
| **Hex** | **Interact** while a target is bound | Hex for 15 s: -10 % defence; if it dies hexed, you get 15 % of your max HP back. |
| **Misty Step** | **Jump** while a target is bound | Leap to it (after a Bolt) or warp to its far side (after a Burst). |
| **Hellish Rebuke** | **Interact** right after an enemy hits you | The attacker flinches and catches green fire. 30 % of your max stamina, once every 6 s. |
| **Dimension Door** | hold the vocation button + **d-pad up** (keyboard: **B**) | Aim (a pillar of frost light marks the spot, up to 500 ft), press again to open a door, walk through it. Press once more to close it. |

## Skills

Learned at the Vocation Guild with Discipline (DCP), equipped like any weapon skill.

| Skill | Rank | DCP | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| Eldritch Slash | 1 | 300 | A sweeping arc of eldritch force that cleaves foes from afar (sword hit x2, the wave x3 damage). |
| Tasha's Caustic Brew | 1 | 300 | A chant, then a torrent of acid that washes over the foes before you and poisons them. |
| Misty Strike | 2 | 500 | Step through the mist behind a foe and strike before they can turn. Works from a jump. |
| Misty Dive | 3 | 800 | Vanish into mist and plunge down on a foe from above. Works from the air. On a big monster you land on its body. |
| Eldritch Blast | 5 | 1500 | A searing beam of eldritch energy from your off hand. Works from the air. |
| Archfey Combo | 7 | 2500 | A fey-born flurry: vanish and strike from every side in quick succession. |
| Eldritch Smite | 8 | 3000 | A crushing two-part overhead blow that knocks even great foes to the ground. Uses a **spell slot**. |
| Tasha's Otherworldly Guise | 9 | 4000 | A spectral armour from beyond for 60 s (see below). Uses a **spell slot** and a quarter of your stamina. |

Each skill has a second level for 100 DCP at the same rank (it's there for the game's skill menus; it doesn't change
the skill). A hit strong enough to make you flinch or fall interrupts a chant (Caustic Brew, Guise).

## Spell slots

Like a warlock's pact magic: **Eldritch Smite** and **Tasha's Otherworldly Guise** each use a spell slot.
- You have **1 slot at level 1**, one more every 15 levels (15, 30, 45, 60), **at most 5**.
- A used slot comes back after **20 s**; several come back one after another. Menus don't count.
- With no slot free, the two skills are greyed out and can't be used. The Guise uses its slot when the spell takes
  effect, so an interrupted chant costs none. Renewing an active Guise uses one too.
- **On the HUD:** a row of circles under the stamina bar - a violet gem when the slot is ready, empty when used, and it
  grows back like the phases of the moon while recharging. The position (3 choices), size and on/off are in the menu.

**Tasha's Otherworldly Guise** (60 s, paused in menus):
- +20 % Defense and Magick Defense (on the status screen)
- **Immune** to Caught Fire, Torched, Blighted and Fulminant Poison; fire damage halved
- **Levitate:** hold Jump in the air, steer with the stick; let go and hold again to float once more in the same jump
  (no Eldritch Bolt while levitating)
- A ghostly armour

CrawfishChowder/GDSCHackathon.readme:
# Red Alert
A first-person survival game in a habitat module. Over one five-minute shift, life-critical systems fail and you fix them by hand. One mistake kills you instantly, and the mission log tells you which **real spaceflight disaster** your mistake mirrors. Players leave thinking: *astronauts really put their lives on the line.*

## Team
- [Gerald Lê](https://github.com/g34rmeister)
- [Brandon Braswell](https://github.com/brandonBraswell)
- [Eddie Summitt](https://github.com/EdwardSummitt)
- [Calvin Gavin](https://github.com/CrawfishChowder)
- [Scott Sonnier](https://github.com/scotty2hottyy)

## About
**What we built.** Red Alert is a Godot 4.7 game, in GDScript. You keep a habitat alive through one shift while its systems break. Each crisis is fixed at its own station:

| Crisis | Station | How you fix it |
|---|---|---|
| Reactor | center console | repeat the control sequence, or balance three coolant loops |
| Oxygen | left console | enter the filter code, or find and seal the leaking joint |
| CO2 | right console | build the Apollo 13 scrubber adapter, or switch to the cool, regenerated scrubber bed |
| Power | breaker box | open the cover, cycle the main breaker OFF then ON |
| Dust storm | east-wall solar array | balance power between life support, heaters and comms, or tilt the array toward the sun |

Each crisis has two minigames. The first time you see a crisis you get the original, and after that they alternate.

Two characters guide you:
- **HAL**, a cold computer, runs the alarms.
- **Sam**, a crewmate stuck in another module, coaches you over the radio.

Your heart rate climbs under pressure, and above 120 BPM your hands shake (the minigames jitter). Hold **B** to breathe slowly.

**The problem it solves.** Space-safety history (Apollo 1, Soyuz 11, Apollo 13) is usually taught as dates and names. Red Alert makes it *felt*:
- **When you fail,** the run ends with an accurate lesson about the real incident: SL-1 (1961), Chernobyl (1986), Apollo 1 (1967), the Soyuz T-10-1 pad abort (1983), Soyuz 11 (1971), Apollo 13 (1970), or the Opportunity (2018) and Spirit (2010) rovers. HAL reads the incident aloud.
- **When you succeed,** a card shows how a real crew pulled through: Apollo 12, Apollo 13, Kilopower, or Spirit and Opportunity.
- **At the end of the shift,** you see an A–F grade and a comparison with real crews (Scott Kelly, Valeri Polyakov, Apollo 13).

It's aimed at STEM classrooms, museums and outreach events.

**What we did.**
- **Systems:** the game is built around autoload singletons that talk through signals: the malfunction manager, minigame host, mission log, voice, sound, life support, stress, achievements, settings and save data.
- **Modes:** an authored **Story shift** (best first play), a random **Start shift**, **Practice** (mistakes show "this would have killed you" instead of ending the run) and **Hard** (half the time).
- **Built in code:** the room, props, live console monitors (SubViewports), signage, a procedural Mars window, the title backdrop, and the alarm, hum and heartbeat sounds are all generated in code from Godot primitives and shaders.
- **Sound:** recorded effects from the Sonniss GDC bundle (credited), a 3D alarm ping at the broken station, room reverb, and Sam on a filtered radio channel.
- **Accessibility and personalization:** always-on captions, high contrast, reduce motion, separate SFX and voice volume, text/UI scale, fullscreen and VSync, a shadows toggle and a **Performance mode** for slow laptops (suggested automatically below 55 FPS), hide HUD, adjustable sensitivity and invert Y, keyboard shortcuts in every minigame, PS5 DualSense controller support, and status that's never shown by color alone. New players get a guided tutorial, an **H** controls panel and a "NEW CRISIS" brief (with extra time) the first time each crisis appears.
- **Replay value:** six achievements, an A–F shift grade with best saved, a mission log of every crew member lost, and a shift timeline on the end screens.
- **Tests:** 70 headless test scenes (including a full end-to-end shift and robustness suites) plus a smoke run, all run by `tools/run_tests.sh`.

**External tools and APIs.**
- **NASA DONKI** (`api.nasa.gov`): the latest real solar flare. M-class and X-class flares shorten every countdown and trigger a mid-shift blackout. If the API is unreachable, the game falls back to the last cached flare, then to an offline message. *External API #1.*
- **Open Notify** (`api.open-notify.org`): the number and names of people in space right now. *External API #2.*
- **ElevenLabs** (sponsor): all 38 HAL and Sam lines, written by the team, are voiced with ElevenLabs text-to-speech (HAL: "Daniel", Sam: "Rachel") via `tools/generate_voices.py`. Every line is also captioned.
- **Godot Engine 4.7:** the game engine.
- **Sonniss GDC 2015 Game Audio Bundle:** 13 royalty-free recorded sound effects, trimmed and converted by us. Sources are listed in [`red-alert/assets/sfx/CREDITS.md`](red-alert/assets/sfx/CREDITS.md).
- **NASA life-support planning figures:** about 0.84 kg of oxygen and about 1 kg of CO2 per crew member per day.
- **Historical facts:** summarized in our own words from public NASA and historical records.

**Boilerplate.** None, apart from the default files Godot generates for a new project (`project.godot`, `icon.svg`, `.gitattributes`, `.editorconfig`). No external starter code or templates were used.

**AI-generated / AI-assisted code.** This project used AI assistance, as the rules allow:
- **Claude (Claude Code):** planning, task tickets, code review, merge resolution, tests and documentation.
- **Gemini (Google Antigravity):** implemented most features from those tickets.
- **GPT Codex and GitHub Copilot:** used by some teammates as coding assistants, including on the PS Vita controller work.

The team designed the game, wrote the briefs, and reviewed and tested every change. Each member owns and can explain specific systems (see [`docs/QA_SHEET.md`

gdaroch/interview-quiz.readme:
# interview-quiz

A local multiple-choice quiz for interview study. Each round draws random questions from a fixed bank, shows feedback with an explanation after every answer, and ends with a final score.

**Status: work in progress.** The question bank and its startup validation exist. The round logic and the UI are still being built (groups 4-6 of the OpenSpec change `quiz-game`).

## Live demo

Deployed on Cloudflare: https://interview-quiz.gonzalodaroch.workers.dev/

## Requirements

- Node.js and npm

## Commands

```bash
npm install            # install dependencies
npm run dev            # start the Vite dev server
npm run build          # production build into dist/
npm test               # unit tests (Vitest)
npm run test:e2e       # end-to-end tests (Playwright, Chromium)
```

The first time you run the e2e tests, install the browser with `npx playwright install chromium`.

## Editing the question bank

Questions live in `src/questions.json`, a JSON array of question objects. Example with two questions: a minimal one, and one with the optional `code` field.

```json
[
  {
    "id": "js-typeof-null",
    "topic": "javascript",
    "question": "What does typeof null return?",
    "options": ["\"null\"", "\"object\"", "\"undefined\""],
    "answer": 1,
    "explanation": "A historical quirk of JavaScript: typeof null is \"object\"."
  },
  {
    "id": "js-closure-counter",
    "topic": "javascript",
    "question": "What does the last line print?",
    "options": ["0", "1", "2", "undefined"],
    "answer": 2,
    "explanation": "The returned function keeps access to count, so each call increments the same variable.",
    "code": {
      "language": "javascript",
      "lines": [
        "function makeCounter() {",
        "  let count = 0;",
        "  return () => ++count;",
        "}",
        "const next = makeCounter();",
        "next();",
        "console.log(next());"
      ]
    }
  }
]
```

Fields of each question:

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Unique in the whole file. |
| `topic` | string | yes | Subject of the question. |
| `question` | string | yes | The question text. |
| `options` | array of strings | yes | At least 2 entries; each one a non-empty string. |
| `answer` | integer | yes | 0-based index of the correct option in the original `options` order (the game shuffles the options itself). |
| `explanation` | string | yes | Shown after the player answers. |
| `code` | object | no | Code snippet shown with the question. |
| `code.language` | string | if `code` is present | Non-empty. Highlighted languages: `javascript`, `typescript`, `css`, `html`. Any other language is shown as plain text. |
| `code.lines` | array of strings | if `code` is present | Non-empty; one string per line of code. |

The bank is validated at startup (`src/parse.js` checks that the file is valid JSON, `src/validate.js` checks the questions). If the file is not valid JSON, or any question is invalid, the game does not start: an error screen lists every problem found, not just the first one.

## Round size

`QUESTIONS_PER_ROUND` in `src/config.js` sets how many questions a round has (currently 15). If the bank has fewer questions, all of them are used.

## Project structure

```
src/
  config.js          # QUESTIONS_PER_ROUND
  questions.json     # question bank
  validate.js        # bank validation
  main.js, style.css # app entry and styles
  *.test.js          # unit tests
e2e/                 # Playwright tests
openspec/            # OpenSpec specs and the quiz-game change (proposal, design, tasks)
```

irnutsmurt/Street-Alpha-3-Dreamcast-Reco.readme:
# SFA3 Native — Street Fighter Alpha 3 (Dreamcast) static recompilation

A native PC port (Linux and Windows) of the **US Dreamcast version of Street
Fighter Alpha 3**, built by **statically recompiling** the game's SH-4 machine
code into C and pairing it with a native runtime (Vulkan renderer, SDL3
input/audio). It is not an emulator: no CPU is interpreted or JIT-compiled at
runtime.

> **Built 100% with AI.** All of this project's code, from the recompiler and
> runtime to the setup app and build tooling, was written by AI
> ([Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code), Anthropic's Claude), with a
> human directing, testing and play-testing it.

## You need your own copy of the game

**Use your own legally acquired copy of Street Fighter Alpha 3 for the Sega
Dreamcast (USA release).** This project does not include the game, and it
does not tell you where to download it.

Only this release is supported:

| | |
|---|---|
| Title | Street Fighter Alpha 3 (USA), Sega Dreamcast |
| Product number | T-1203N |
| Version | v1.001 |
| Region | NTSC-U (US) |

Other regions (the Japanese *Street Fighter Zero 3*, the European PAL release)
are rejected: the recompiler is tied to this exact build's code. The setup
checks your disc's main executable before doing anything else.

## This repository contains no game data

Nothing from the game ships here: no code, assets or recompiled output. The
setup reads the disc image you made from your own disc, verifies it,
recompiles it and builds the executable on your own machine. Everything
derived from the game stays on your machine (`build/` in a checkout, or the
install folder the setup app creates) and must not be redistributed.

## 1. Dump your disc

Dreamcast GD-ROMs can't be read by ordinary PC drives. Use one of:

- **Dreamcast + SD card adapter**: run a GD-ROM ripping homebrew (e.g. *SD Rip*)
  from a boot disc or ODE, rip to SD card, copy the resulting `.gdi` set to your PC.
- **Dreamcast + Broadband Adapter**: run `httpd-ack` and download the tracks over
  your network (the method documented by Redump).
- **Dreamcast + coder's cable / serial**: dcload-based rippers (slow but works).
- **PC "swap trick"** with a compatible drive (see Redump's GD-ROM dumping guide).

You should end up with a `.gdi` file plus `track01.bin`, `track02.raw`,
`track03.bin`. A Redump CUE/BIN set or a CHD (`chdman createcd`) of it works too.

## 2. Build

### The easy way: the setup app

Download `SFA3-Setup` for your system from the
[Releases](https://github.com/irnutsmurt/Street-Alpha-3-Dreamcast-Recomp/releases)
page, unpack it and run it. Choose your disc
image (GDI, CUE/BIN or CHD) and an install folder, press **Convert**, then
**Play**. It takes about 5 minutes and needs nothing else installed: the app
carries its own C compiler (Zig), SDL3 and the port's runtime. The game needs a
Vulkan graphics driver: on Windows, Windows 10 or 11; on Linux, glibc 2.31 or
newer (Ubuntu 20.04, Debian 11, Fedora 32 or later). `SFA3-Setup --convert IMAGE FOLDER` does the
same without the window.

The install keeps its own compact copy of the game's data (about 700 MB:
the disc's files, without the empty part of the disc), so afterwards your disc
image can be moved or deleted.

**Updating:** run the setup app again. It finds your install and offers
**Update**: no disc image needed, about 20 seconds, and your saves and
settings stay as they are. The app also tells you when a new version of
itself is out (**Get it** downloads it and updates the game right after).

When it's done, the app has added the game to your Start Menu (Windows) or app
menu (Linux), and to your desktop if you left that ticked. **Add to Steam**
puts it in your Steam library as a non-Steam game, so it works from Big
Picture and on a Steam Deck. The library artwork is downloaded from
[SteamGridDB](https://www.steamgriddb.com/game/1647) at that moment, onto your
machine only (credits below).

### From source (developers)

Requirements: Python 3.9+, CMake, Ninja, a C/C++ compiler (GCC or Clang),
Vulkan SDK/headers + `glslc`, SDL3.

```sh
./sfa3port.py setup "/path/to/Street Fighter Alpha 3.gdi"
```

The pipeline:

1. **Extract** — reads the GD-ROM high-density area's ISO9660 filesystem.
2. **Verify** — checks the SHA-1 of `1ST_READ.BIN` against the known release
   (so any dump format of the same disc validates).
3. **Recompile** — `tools/recomp` disassembles the main executable
   (`1ST_READ.BIN`, loaded at `0x8C010000`) and the 111 per-character code
   overlays (`PLnnA/B/C.BIN`, linked for the player slots at `0x8C800000`,
   `0x8C814000` and `0x8C828000`) and emits C.
4. **Build** — compiles generated C + `runtime/` into `build/cmake/sfa3`.

After changing the recompiler or runtime: `./sfa3port.py rebuild`.

Packaging the setup app (Linux and Windows, both from Linux):

- Zig 0.17 for Linux in `build/toolchain/`, for Windows in `build/toolchain/win/`.
- `./sfa3port.py dev-libs` builds the prebuilt parts players get into
  `build/lib/<platform>/` and `build/tools/<platform>/`: SDL3, the runtime
  library, what the game links for Vulkan, the Windows manifest (UTF-8 paths)
  and the CHD helper. Linux targets glibc 2.31.
- `python3 tools/make_bundle.py` makes the downloads in `build/dist/`. It needs
  PyInstaller in `build/venv`, and for Windows, Windows Python 3.14 with
  PyInstaller in the Wine prefix `build/wine` (`C:\Python314`).

## 3. Play

Run `./build/cmake/sfa3`.

| Keyboard | Dreamcast |
|---|---|
| Arrows / WASD | D-pad |
| Enter | Start |
| U, I, O | X, Y, L trigger (punches) |
| J, K, L | A, B, R trigger (kicks) |
| F1 or Esc | display settings overlay (pauses the game, except in netplay); on the title screen Esc asks QUIT GAME? |
| F11 or Alt+Enter | fullscreen |

Gamepads work too (Back opens the settings menu; on the title screen it asks
QUIT GAME?, YES / NO). Default gamepad layout:
X / Y / RB = light / medium / heavy punch, A / B / RT = light / medium / heavy kick,
LB / LT = all three punches / kicks

itaskaev2/wizardry8-4k.readme:
# Wizardry 8 — 4K без рамок + HD-интерфейс (установщик для Steam-версии)

**English version: [README.en.md](README.en.md)** | Русский

Wizardry 8 из Steam в родном разрешении монитора (например 4K), на весь экран без рамок, с чётким HD-текстом,
интерфейсом без растяжения и широкими HD-фонами. Всё ставится одним скриптом и так же одним скриптом убирается.

## До и после

![Главное меню: до и после](docs/compare_menu.jpg)

![Игровой экран: до и после](docs/compare_game.jpg)

![Текст крупно, пиксели 4K 1:1](docs/compare_text.jpg)

| | Steam-версия как есть | После установки |
|---|---|---|
| Разрешение | 800x600, 16 бит (Glide через nGlide) | родное разрешение монитора, 32 бит (DirectX через dgVoodoo2) |
| Экран | полный экран с низким разрешением | весь экран без рамок, Alt+Tab без смены режима монитора |
| Сглаживание | нет | 8x MSAA, 16x анизотропная фильтрация |
| Интерфейс | растянут на 16:9, портреты сплюснуты | пропорции сохранены, портреты и панели по краям экрана |
| Текст | пиксельный шрифт 640x480, размыт | TrueType-шрифт в родном разрешении, включая подсказки |
| Фоны меню, загрузки, привала | 640x480, растянуты | широкие HD-фоны 16:9 |
| Портреты персонажей | 640x480, размыты | HD во всех трёх размерах, с морганием и речью |
| Инвентарь, отряд, создание персонажа | чёрные полосы по бокам | по бокам камень из самой игры |
| Тексты локаций (дневники, надписи) в русской версии | по-английски | по-русски (тексты из Fan Patch) |
| Логотип 3dfx при запуске | есть | нет |

Картинки «до» сняты с исходного кадра интерфейса 640x480: в меню он растянут на 16:9 так же, как его растягивает
игра; на игровом экране интерфейс показан в пропорциях 4:3.

## Что нужно

- Windows 10 или 11, видеокарта с Direct3D 11, лучше монитор 16:9.
- Wizardry 8 из Steam.
- **Fan Patch 1.28** — неофициальный патч, в Steam его нет, скачивается отдельно (шаг 2).
- **dgVoodoo2** — в Steam его тоже нет; установщик скачает его сам (шаг 4).
- Интернет на время установки и около 80 МБ на диске.

## Установка

1. **Установить Wizardry 8 в Steam.**

2. **Скачать Fan Patch 1.28** и распаковать архив в папку игры (`...\steamapps\common\Wizardry8`, там, где
   `Wiz8.exe`), заменяя файлы:
   - [GamePressure — Fan Patch v.1.2.8 Build 6709](https://www.gamepressure.com/download/wizardry-8-fan-patch-v128-build-6709-mod/z2152ee) (12.4 МБ);
   - запасной вариант: [ModHQ](https://mods.rpghq.org/wizardry-8/350301) (сайт сначала проверяет, что вы не бот).

   Новости и сборки патча — в группе автора [Cosmic Forge во ВКонтакте](https://vk.com/club177350708).

3. **Запустить `Wiz8_v128.exe`** из папки игры, выбрать язык, в лаунчере патча нажать **«Проверить обновления»**
   (Check for updates) и дать ему обновиться. Потом закрыть игру.

4. **Скачать этот установщик**: кнопка **Code → Download ZIP** на этой странице, распаковать куда угодно и дважды
   щёлкнуть `install.cmd`. Установщик сам:
   - найдёт игру в библиотеках Steam;
   - скачает [dgVoodoo2 2.87.5 с официального GitHub](https://github.com/dege-diosg/dgVoodoo2/releases/tag/v2.87.5)
     и сверит его SHA-256 (сайт автора: [dege.freeweb.hu](http://dege.freeweb.hu/));
   - докачает HD-фоны и шрифты (в ZIP с GitHub вместо них лежат ссылки Git LFS) и сверит их SHA-256;
   - настроит разрешение, dgVoodoo2, HD-интерфейс, выключит логотип 3dfx и создаст ярлык на рабочем столе.

5. **Играть через ярлык «Wizardry 8 (Fan Patch 4K)»** на рабочем столе. Кнопка «Играть» в Steam запускает
   оригинальный `Wiz8.exe` без патча и мода.

**Удалить:** закрыть игру и дважды щёлкнуть `uninstall.cmd`. Все заменённые файлы вернутся как были, добавленные
удалятся, ярлык и настройка nGlide восстановятся.

## Если что-то не так

| Сообщение или симптом | Что делать |
|---|---|
| `Wiz8_v128.exe (Fan Patch 1.28) not found` | не распакован Fan Patch, см. шаг 2 |
| `Wiz8_v128.exe has an unknown SHA-256` | у вас другой exe патча. Мод работает только с exe из Fan Patch 1.28 (SHA-256 `fdca6d9c…a9fb824`); скачайте патч по ссылкам из шага 2 |
| `Wiz8.dll is a Fan Patch build this package was not checked with` | только предупреждение: проверено на сборках 6709 и 6735, с более новой мод скорее всего тоже работает |
| `The game is running from this folder` | закройте игру и повторите |
| антивирус ругается на `Wiz8_v128.exe` | патч правит игру в памяти. Авторы патча сами дают проверку этого файла: [VirusTotal](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file/fdca6d9cd0940034191e82b8e2900de26bb25e381c74128dcb8967360a9fb824/detection) |
| нет интернета | положите [`dgVoodoo2_87_5.zip`](https://github.com/dege-diosg/dgVoodoo2/releases/download/v2.87.5/dgVoodoo2_87_5.zip) в `<игра>\mods\` и скачайте установщик через `git clone` (с Git LFS), затем `install.ps1 -Offline` |
| игра сворачивается при переключении окон | так работает полноэкранный режим без рамок, вернуться — Alt+Tab |
| растянутая картинка | игра запущена кнопкой Steam, а не ярлыком «Wizardry 8 (Fan Patch 4K)» |

## Параметры установщика

Из PowerShell: `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1 [ключи]`

| Ключ | Что делает |
|---|---|
| `-GamePath "D:\...\Wizardry8"` | указать папку игры вручную (не Steam или не нашлась) |
| `-Width 2560 -Height 1440` | другое разрешение вместо разрешения монитора |
| `-DetectOnly` | только найти игру, проверить версии и разрешение |
| `-WhatIf` | показать, что будет сделано, ничего не меняя |
| `-NoBackgrounds` | без HD-фонов (−71 МБ) |
| `-NoPortraits` | без HD-портретов (−119 МБ) |
| `-NoRusTexts` | оставить тексты локаций по-английски в русской версии |
| `-NoHdUi` | только разрешение и экран без рамок, без HD-интерфейса |
| `-ResetConfig` | заменить уже существующие `wiz8hd.ini` / `dgVoodoo.conf` настройками по умолчанию |
| `-NoShortcut`, `-SkipNGlide`, `-Offline` | без ярлыка / без настройки nGlide / ничего не скачивать |

Повторный запуск обновляет установку на месте; ваши `wiz8hd.ini` и `dgVoodoo.conf` сохраняются. Если в
сохранённом `wiz8hd.ini` стоит `Sprites=0` (так было до HD-портретов), установщик предупр

kennynguyen216/FirstPrinciples.readme:
# FirstPrinciples

FirstPrinciples is a C++20 game engine with a Qt scene editor and an SDL3 runtime for macOS and
Windows. It includes an entity component system, hot-reloadable C++ scripts, 2D and 3D rendering,
physics, animation, audio, game UI and peer-to-peer multiplayer.

AI was heavily used in all systems except the core memory and fiber systems.

Game projects live under `Projects/` and share the engine in `src/` and `Engine/Content/`.
DeadAirFreight is the game under active development in `Projects/DeadAirFreight`.
`Projects/Sample` contains example scenes and scripts for trying the features.

## Get the source

Clone with submodules:

```bash
git clone --recursive https://github.com/kennynguyen216/FirstPrinciples.git
cd FirstPrinciples
```

Run the build and tool commands below from the repository root.

For an existing clone, initialize dependencies with `git submodule update --init`.

## Build and run

### macOS

Install Homebrew, then run:

```bash
Scripts/Setup.sh
Scripts/Build.sh
Projects/Sample/Binaries/Debug/Editor
```

Setup installs Premake, SDL3, Qt and 7-Zip, and downloads the optional Ultralight game UI SDK.
Use `Scripts/Build.sh release` for an optimized build. Pass a project folder to build another
game, such as `Scripts/Build.sh debug Projects/DeadAirFreight`.

### Windows

1. Install Visual Studio 2022 or 2026 with Desktop development with C++.
2. Install a 64-bit MSVC Qt 6 kit. Kits under `C:\Qt` are detected automatically. For another
   location, set `QT_DIR` to the kit directory. MinGW Qt kits are not compatible with this build.
3. From the repository root, run:

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File Scripts\Setup.ps1
Scripts\GenerateProjects.bat
```

Open the generated solution in `Projects\Sample\Build`, choose Debug or Release, set Editor as
the startup project and build. The generator selects the installed Visual Studio C++ toolset.

See [building](docs/building.md) for Xcode, command-line MSBuild, clean builds and build targets.
See [packaging](docs/packaging.md) to create a distributable game.

## First steps

Open a Sample scene in the editor and press Play, or launch the standalone player:

```bash
Projects/Sample/Binaries/Debug/Runtime
```

On Windows, use `Runtime.exe` from the same configuration's output folder.
Start with [projects](docs/projects.md), [the editor](docs/editor.md) and
[components and systems](docs/gameplay.md) when making your own game.

## Documentation

The [documentation index](docs/README.md) describes each guide. Feature docs explain what the
system does, why it exists, how it works and where to find its implementation.

- Development: [projects](docs/projects.md), [components and systems](docs/gameplay.md),
  [C++ scripts](docs/scripting.md), [input](docs/input.md), [save data](docs/save-data.md).
- Editor and content: [editor controls](docs/editor.md), [hierarchy](docs/hierarchy.md),
  [assets](docs/assets.md), [undo and redo](docs/undo-redo.md), [logging](docs/logging.md).
- Graphics: [rendering](docs/rendering.md), [meshes and cameras](docs/meshes-and-cameras.md),
  [materials](docs/materials.md), [shadows](docs/shadows.md), [environment lighting](docs/environment.md),
  [animation](docs/animation.md), [particles](docs/particles.md), [post-processing](docs/post-processing.md),
  [batching](docs/batching.md), [meshlets](docs/meshlets.md), [black holes](docs/black-holes.md).
- Gameplay and sound: [physics](docs/physics.md), [game UI](docs/game-ui.md),
  [audio](docs/audio.md), [spatial audio](docs/spatial-audio.md), [audio demos](docs/audio-demos.md),
  [multiplayer](docs/multiplayer.md), [voice chat](docs/voice-chat.md).
- Engine internals: [core utilities](docs/core.md), [memory](docs/memory.md), [fibers](docs/fibers.md),
  [jobs](docs/jobs.md), [object lifetime](docs/objects.md).
- Verification and reference: [tests](docs/testing.md), [benchmarks](docs/benchmarks.md),
  [dependencies](docs/third-party.md), [current limitations](docs/limitations.md).

## Tests

After building Sample, run:

```bash
Projects/Sample/Binaries/Debug/Tests
```

Use `Tests.exe` on Windows. An optional substring filters cases, such as `Tests Memory`.
See [testing](docs/testing.md) for GPU checks, editor tests and screenshot smoke runs.

Add opt-in multi-octave WideBloom

A WideBloom setting on PostProcess replaces the single quarter resolution
blur with eight octaves. The extracted light is halved down to 1/256 of the
screen, then each smaller octave is added back onto the next larger one with
a tent filter. The glow keeps a sharp core and a soft tail that spans the
screen, like the Gargantua style film glare. Intensity is averaged over the
octaves so BloomIntensity stays comparable. It is off by default, so existing
scenes keep the original bloom.
added juice to combat

Add Schwarzschild black holes with gravitational lensing

A BlackHole component bends light around it in a new fullscreen pass. Every
pixel's ray is traced backwards with the exact Schwarzschild null geodesic
equation, giving the shadow at 2.6 horizon radii, the photon ring and the
lensed accretion disk. The disk is a Novikov-Thorne disk from the innermost
stable orbit, glowing as a blackbody with Doppler and gravitational shifts.
Skyboxes are bent all the way around, and procedural stars fill an empty sky.

GravityBody entities are pulled with the Schwarzschild orbit equation by the
new BlackHoleSystem, through Jolt for dynamic rigid bodies. The scene depth
buffer is now sampled so bent rays can find scene objects.

# Evil in the Land

Anno Domini 1523. The land is dead, and something walks the hills watching.

A cooperative action game for one to five knights in 16th-century plate. Fight the demonic swarm, kneel at the blighted altars and pray while your brothers hold the line, and win back the land piece by piece. The road climbs through seven chapters to the mountain's peak, where the Devil waits in his final shape. A full pilgrimage takes about an hour to an hour and a half.

## Play in your browser

**https://n4dnkg8jjs-create.github.io/Evil-in-the-Land/**

Ride alone or with friends, nothing to install. Everyone just opens the page.

## Profiles

The first time you play, make a profile: your knight's name and, if you like, a PIN so others on the same computer can't play as you. Your profile keeps your harness, settings, silver, armoury and how far you've got, and saves itself as you play. Several people can have profiles on one computer; **switch profile** on the title screen changes who is riding.

Profiles are saved in your browser on this computer, so clearing the browser's site data deletes them, and they don't follow you to another computer yet.

## Play with friends

Nothing to download or run: the host's browser holds the lobby.

1. **The host** opens the page and chooses **Host a Lobby**. The lobby shows a five-letter code, with buttons to copy the code or an invite link.
2. **Friends** open the same page, choose **Join with a Code** and type the code, or just open the invite link. They arrive in the lobby under their profile names.
3. Everyone picks a harness and marks themselves **Ready**. The host chooses difficulty, companions and chapter, then **Ride Out**.

Each friend's knight takes the place of a companion. Companions fill any places that are left, up to five knights in all. If a friend drops out mid-game, a companion carries on in their knight's harness. If the host leaves, the game ends for everyone and they're sent back to the title.

Players find each other through the free PeerJS matchmaking service, then connect directly browser to browser. Everyone needs an internet connection. A few strict networks, such as some offices, schools and mobile hotspots, block direct connections; if friends can't join, try another network, or use the local server below.

## Run the game yourself (optional)

You need **Node.js 18 or newer**, free from https://nodejs.org (the "LTS" download).

- **Windows:** double-click `start-windows.bat`
- **macOS:** double-click `start-mac.command`. The first time, macOS may ask you to allow it: right-click → Open.
- **Linux:** run `./start-linux.sh`, or `node server.js`

Leave the server window open while you play, then open **http://localhost:7777** in Chrome, Edge or Firefox.

The very first time, the host computer needs internet so the server can download the 3D engine (Three.js). It keeps a copy in the `vendor` folder, so after that nobody needs internet to play.

### Lobbies on the local server

Opened from your own server, the game still uses five-letter lobbies by default. If the matchmaking service can't be reached, **Host a Lobby** opens the lobby on your server instead and shows a four-letter code. Friends on the same network open the server's address, such as `http://192.168.1.20:7777`, and join with that code.

If port 7777 is taken, start the server on another one: `PORT=7788 node server.js`. On Windows, use `set PORT=7788` then `node server.js`.

## Controls

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| W A S D | Move |
| Mouse | Look |
| Left click | Strike; click again to chain the combo |
| Right click | Heavy blow |
| Q (hold) | Guard. Raise it just before a blow lands to parry |
| Space | Roll |
| Shift | Run |
| Ctrl | Shift lock: your knight faces where the camera looks, for strafing. Settings can move it to Caps Lock or Tab |
| E (hold) | Kneel and pray at an altar, or raise a fallen knight |
| R | Use your relic |
| H | Drink a healing draught |
| F | Trade at the sutler's wagon |
| Mouse wheel | Camera distance |
| Esc | Pause |

## On the road

- **Prayer and altars.** Kneel at each blighted altar and hold your prayer while the others defend you. Each answered prayer heals the land around it.
- **Dread.** Fear rises when you stand alone in the blight, when demons close in, when you are wounded, and when the hooded figure on the ridge is watching. As it rises you will hear whispers, the edges of the screen go dark, and you will see things that are not there. At its worst your hands shake. Praying, staying near your fellow knights and standing in the light of cleansed altars bring it down.
- **It gets worse.** Each chapter deeper into the blight, fear builds faster and things start happening on the road: a figure standing in your way, something crossing the path in the fog, a silence broken by a scream, footsteps behind you, your own name whispered, and the light going out. Every player experiences these separately.
- **The First Company.** Twenty knights took this road a year before you and never came back. Their graves lie beside it, each marked with a cross and a helm, and their chaplain's pages are on the graves. Walk up to one to read it.
- **The sutler's wagon.** Every road starts at a trader's wagon. Spend the silver you earn from kills, altars, finished roads and found pages on new weapons, tempered blades, stronger armour, a blessed relic and healing draughts. Purchases are saved in your profile.

## Your own music

The score is rendered by the game itself: choir, strings, low brass and war drums. To use recorded music instead, put audio files in `public/audio` with these names (`.ogg`, `.mp3`, `.wav`, `.m4a` or `.flac`):

- `music_explore` while travelling
- `music_battle` in heavy fighting
- `music_prayer` while you kneel at an altar
- `music_boss` for the great fights
- `music_victory` when the land is healed

Any you leave out fall back to the built-in score. Only use music you have the rights to.

# 決戰（Kessen）— MVP

網頁即時戰略遊戲。技術：TypeScript + Vite + Three.js。戰鬥核心（`src/sim`）沿用士氣模擬器，規則為設計文件 v2 士氣調整＋ v3 忍者調整（`src/sim/game-rules.ts`）。

## 開發
```bash
npm install
npm run dev          # http://localhost:5173 ；同一個 Wi-Fi 的手機可用終端機顯示的區網網址開啟
npm run typecheck
npm run build        # 一般建置，輸出到 dist/，可部署到 GitHub Pages
npm run build:single # 單一 HTML（dist/kessen-m1.html）
```

## 目前進度：M6 完成（M1～M6、觀戰模式）；下一步 M7（手機效能、平衡、跨瀏覽器）
- 戰場：1000 m × 700 m，中央小丘與寺廟、西側森林與村落、東側稻田與補給點
- 鏡頭：WASD／畫面邊緣平移、Q E／中鍵旋轉、滾輪縮放；觸控單指平移、雙指縮放旋轉
- 部隊：長槍足輕（馬場信春）與大將旗本；點選、移動、連點跑步、拖曳拉出陣線（寬度與朝向）
- 介面：軍勢列、倒數、暫停（暫停中可下指令）、速度、部隊旗牌、操作說明、直向提示、FPS
- M2：雙方各 8 隊（624 人）依設計文件佈陣；陣型切換（橫陣／密集陣＝槍衾／散開）；框選、Ctrl+A、編組（Ctrl+數字）；多隊拉陣線時依位置排序；自動畫質（連續 3 秒低於 30 fps 降解析度）；效能讀數（fps、人數、draw call、解析度）
- M3：攻擊指令（右鍵／點敵軍，連點兩下全程突擊）；弓兵自動進入射程並自由射擊；上杉軍暫以「守原位、80 m 內迎擊」代替 AI
- M3 畫面：接戰時雙方前排靠攏並刺擊；陣亡士兵倒地留在戰場（近戰倒在敵方那側，箭傷等箭落地才倒）；箭矢拋物線；衝鋒揚塵與撞退；
  浮字（衝鋒、側擊、背襲、潰走、重整、討死、槍衾受阻）；旗號角標（昂／搖／整、交戰中）；潰逃士兵散開奔逃
- M4：軍勢列顯示數值與門檻刻度（20 總崩潰、50 軍心動搖、80）；軍勢增減以浮動標籤顯示原因；軍心動搖與總崩潰提示
- M4：部隊資訊面板（選取一隊或點敵軍）：士氣與狀態門檻、持續加成（大將、寺廟、典廄）、地形、接戰方位（正面／側面／背面、居高）、10 秒內士氣打擊、重整倒數、箭矢、武將
- M4：連鎖潰逃可視化（潰走部隊擴散出影響半徑紅圈，波及友軍浮出「友軍潰走 −10」，附近敵軍「敵潰 +5」）；被包圍提示
- M4：正面／側面／背面三色扇區（資訊面板中的部隊、滑鼠指著的敵軍、攻擊目標）
- M4：地形秘密（沼澤、森林小徑、伏兵地）探明後才畫在地圖上並提示；移動指令與資訊面板顯示地形效果
- M5：出陣畫面選忍者眾（三ツ者／伊賀眾／甲賀眾）；敵方忍者眾隨機；網址 `#clan=iga&foe=koga&seed=42` 可指定（換忍者眾會重新載入）
- M5：上杉軍改由 `sim/ai.ts` 指揮（固守／進攻判斷、武將技、軍略、忍術）；武田軍只有「自動」狀態的忍者由 AI 移動
- M5：戰場迷霧：看不到的敵軍不顯示；察覺＝虛線「?」旗在概略位置；識別＝兵種與概略士氣（虛線士氣條、約略兵數）；洞悉＝確切士氣、近況、武將技冷卻（旗號金色眼睛）。追擊與射擊只用看得到的位置
- M5：武將技、鬨聲、軍略（大將面板）按鈕與說明、冷卻；右側「技」與 `R` 對選取部隊施放；旗牌金點＝武將技可用；被「看破」時停用
- M5：忍者：「忍」旗牌選取（連點兩下移鏡頭）、地圖上點忍者旗號選取；點地面移動後待命，被發現自動撤退；忍術面板（共用冷卻 90 秒、80 m 射程圈、選目標提示）
- M5：敵我武將技、軍略、忍術的浮字與提示；霧隱煙霧、物見範圍；敵方確切軍勢需我方軍師在世
- 觀戰模式（AI 對 AI）：出陣畫面「觀戰」分頁或網址 `#mode=watch`；導播鏡頭、視野切換（全知／武田／上杉）、左上戰報、速度 5×、勝負結算（再看一場／重播）。網址加 `go=1` 跳過出陣畫面
- M6：指揮模式也有勝負判定與結算（勝利／敗北、再戰一場、重新挑戰、檢視戰場）；據點地圖標籤、點據點看效果／佔領進度／援軍倒數、全據點勝利倒數、奪取與失去提示、放火冒煙；村落援軍加入旗牌
- M6：玩家「撤退」指令（右側「退」或 T）：脫離接戰退到主將附近，撤退中不還手、不連累友軍士氣、不扣軍勢；退到定點才結束
- 美術（M6）：`art/manifest.json`（59 張的提示詞）→ `tools/gen-art.mjs`（Gemini 生成到 `art/out/`，不進版控）→ `tools/pack-art.mjs`（縮成 WebP 到 `art/web/`，進版控）→ `src/game/art.ts`（建置時內嵌；沒有圖檔就退回漢字與色塊）。已用上：肖像（旗牌、資訊面板、出陣忍者眾、結算）、技能與忍術圖示（面板按鈕）、家紋（軍勢列、結算、旗號淡印）、標題與一騎討插畫（出陣、結算背景）
- 兵種（2026-10-21）：新增鐵砲足輕（武田）與大筒（上杉），兩軍編制不同；箭雨濺射、擁擠減速、AI 側擊反應讓「全軍一團」不再是最佳解；地形多座山丘與緩坡、兩條溪流與渡口（`two`）成為預設。`tools/strategy.ts` 量各種方針勝率
- 情報 v2（2026-10-21，預設）：視野縮小、識別要觀察、情報會退化、開戰不知敵方佈陣；左上情報讀數與未探索遮罩。`#ai=fog1` 回舊版比較
- 地圖（2026-10-21）：合成貼圖地表（草地、林地、稻田田塊、土路）、外圍犀川與千曲川、遠山、灌木石頭；水域規則（涉水減速、不能衝鋒、半渡而擊）以 `streams` 規則選用，`#ai=two|east` 試玩
- 2026-10-24 八幡原地圖：依第四次川中島之戰地理重做（千曲川與三渡口、妻女山、茶臼山、小島田／八幡社／丹波島），兩軍佈陣不對稱
- 2026-10-24 別働隊與朝霧：武田三隊開場不在場，第 3 分多從妻女山方向渡河趕到；開戰 90 秒內有朝霧、視野減半
- 2026-10-24 歷史導入：第一次開啟播放約 2 分鐘的川中島之戰小動畫（八幕浮世繪場景圖慢速推拉、Gemini 語音合成的日文旁白 Charon、繁中加日文字幕、可略過；出陣畫面「川中島の戦い」鈕可重看）。旁白與場景圖在開發時生成後內嵌（`src/intro/`、`art/web/intro/`，單檔 2.2 → 4.0 MB），遊戲不呼叫任何 API。重生旁白：`node tools/gen-intro-voice.mjs`
- 2026-10-24 配樂層：`src/game/music.ts`，三段外部 MP3（`public/music/council|battle|climax.mp3` → Pages 的 `music/`）；軍議、出陣、別働隊抵達各自切換並淡入淡出，結算時壓低；跟音效鍵共用靜音；單檔 artifact 沒有音樂。來源（Pixabay Content License）：council《Sakura dance background music, traditional japanese》 by 38534292（#165338，原 4:26 剪成前 120 秒淡出、112 kbps）；battle《Sport Sequence Taiko Loop》 by Sonican（#558900，原 256 kbps 轉 128 kbps）；climax《Against All Gods (Epic Viking Tribal Adventure Music)》 by joelfazhari（#464889，轉 128 kbps）
- 2026-10-24 決策卡：別働隊抵達時請示夾擊方式；朝霧中可選「趁霧前推到河岸」；友軍動搖卡至少隔 60 秒。大名模式 240 局 不問 48%／全採納 60%
- 2026-10-24 歷史比例兵數：武田主力 192 人對上杉 308 人（≈ 史實 8,000 對 13,000），別働隊 135 人；騎兵被圍、動搖或損員過多會自行脫離。AI 對 AI 武田 59%、大名模式不介入 48%／全採納 57%
- 2026-10-24 GitHub Pages：公開倉庫 `kuanhuasu-source/kessen`，推到 main 自動建置部署到 https://kuanhuasu-source.github.io/kessen/
- 2026-10-24 視角模式：從決策卡「我親自帶隊」切到主將或騎兵將領視角，鏡頭拉近、只操作該隊、只看該隊視野；士氣 +10、功績加倍，大將討死軍勢再 −30
- 2026-10-23 決策卡：佈陣後部隊自走，遇到狀況由將領請示或軍師提案，戰場暫停等你選方針；舊的大名令併入卡片
- 2026-10-23 戰場功績：擊潰敵隊、討取武將得功，士氣與攻擊加成，旗牌顯示 ★；忍者加快並從軍隊前方出發
- 2026-10-22 音效：Web Audio 合成（出陣、箭雨、放銃、大筒、接戰、衝鋒、潰走、鬨聲、大名令、勝敗…），側欄「音」可靜音
- 2026-10-22 美術補完：兵種圖示 7 張（旗牌角標、資訊面板、配置格）、介面框（結算畫面）
- 2026-10-22 軍師提示：開場識別不足時提醒派忍者偵察（忍者 45 秒後自動歸隊）；軍議配置的各翼方針與將領互換收進「進階」
- 2026-10-22 時間到判定：AI 攻勢追著敵軍走（不再穿過對方站到本陣）、久無接戰且落後方「退卻」結束
- 2026-10-22 忍術精簡：每家只有一種主動忍術，另一種改為自動特性（情報網、防諜、破壞、疑兵）
- 2026-10-22 回顧：據點只給增益不再是勝利條件；大名令留四道；開場佈陣前移、急行軍成線，首戰約 1 分鐘
- 大名模式（2026-10-21，預設）：出陣畫面「軍議」定陣形、攻勢時機、騎兵與撤退線，並可調配置（戰線順序、預備隊、騎兵翼、各翼方針）與互換將領（武將技跟著走）；AI 依方針帶兵；戰中靠軍師建議卡（准／否）、右側「令」的大名令（馳援、集中弓火、騎兵繞後、整頓）與接管單隊介入。全手動模式：軍議選「全手動」或網址 `#cmd=manual`
- AI 動作優化（2026-10-21）：止抖（目標鎖定與決策遲滯）＋戰線式指揮（整條線推進、弓兵在線後、步兵各打正前方、騎兵接戰後繞翼、空手部隊側擊鄰隊對手）。網址 `#ai=legacy|steady|line|crane` 可切換比較；`tools/ai-diag.ts` 量抖動
- 節奏調整（2026-10-21，AI 對 AI 各 60 場，見 `tools/pace.ts`）：重整後士氣上限 50；取消 AI 動搖時有序撤退；AI 主將站戰線後 40 m 並追擊附近動搖／潰走敵軍；弓兵射程 200 m；騎兵奔馳動畫與揚塵。交戰期 330 → 298 秒，總崩潰結束 62% → 87%
- 修正：軍勢門檻改讀規則（v2 總崩潰 25；v2 已取消「軍勢低於 50 全軍緩降」，相關提示移除）
- 速度 0.5× / 1× / 2× / 3×（右側按鈕或 `-` `=`）
- 測試介面：`window.__kessen`（下指令、`advance(秒)` 快轉），給無頭瀏覽器腳本用

## 工具
- `node tools/pace.ts <局數> [設定名…]`：AI 對 AI 批次量測節奏（時長、潰走、重整、AI 撤退、主將與騎兵接戰、移動速度、箭矢命中）；設定含 `base`（legacy AI）、`steady`、`line`、`crane`、`craneT`
- `node tools/ai-diag.ts <局數> [steady|line|crane]`：AI 行為診斷（目標切換、目的地大跳、回頭、落單、待機、戰線散開）
- `node tools/matrix.ts <每組局數>`：忍者眾 3×3 對戰矩陣、各家總勝率、逆轉率、每步模擬耗時
- `node tools/ablate.ts <局數> <武田忍者眾> <上杉忍者眾> [變體…]`：逐項關掉機制看勝率變化（noKiri、noSahou、noRumor、noFog、noNinja…）
- `node tools/gen-art.mjs [--only id,id] [--group 名稱] [--force]`：Gemini 生成美術。自己電腦：`.env` 寫 `GEMINI_API_KEY=...`；雲端工作區（代理注入金鑰）：`NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 GEMINI_API_KEY=proxy node tools/gen-art.mjs`
- `node tools/pack-art.mjs`：把 `art/out` 縮成遊戲用 WebP（`art/web`），幾秒完成；之後 `npm run build:single`
- `node tools/shot.mjs <網址或檔案#參數> <png> [寬] [高] [縮放] [腳本.mjs]`：無頭瀏覽器截圖（用工作區預裝的 Chromium）

## 結構
- `src/sim/`：戰鬥模擬（與士氣模擬器同一份程式；`sim.ts` 新增了陣線寬度、抵達朝向與畫面事件 `S.fx`；`ai.ts` 新增 `S.meta.aiSides` 與手動忍者）
- `src/game/orders.ts`：攻擊指令、弓兵自由射擊（依戰場迷霧）、舊的敵軍守備（測試用）
- `src/game/ninja.ts`：忍者顯示、物見範圍
- `src/game/skills.ts`：武將技、被動、軍略、忍術、忍者眾的名稱與說明
- `src/game/effects.ts`：陣亡、箭矢、揚塵、潰逃波及圈、朝向扇區
- `src/game/terrain.ts`：地形、據點、探明後的地形秘密
- `src/game/units.ts`：士兵 InstancedMesh、陣型槽位、接戰動作、陣亡、旗號
- `src/game/camera.

# Wildreach (working title)

Multiplayer open-world survival, first + third person, UE 5.8, C++. The first playable (fire + frost, Volcanic +
Frozen tundra) runs on placeholder art. See `CHANGELOG.md` for what's built and its known gaps.

## Play with friends

```
Tools\package.ps1          # -> C:\Dev\WildreachBuild\Windows\Wildreach.exe (+ README.txt for players)
Tools\make_installer.ps1   # -> C:\Dev\WildreachBuild\Wildreach-Setup.exe (one file to send friends)
```

Players download `Wildreach-Setup.exe` from the latest GitHub release
(https://github.com/RavenArcher17/Survival-Game/releases/latest/download/Wildreach-Setup.exe, ~1.6 GB). Double-clicking
it installs to the player's own folder (no admin), adds Desktop and Start Menu shortcuts, installs the VC++ runtime only
if it's missing, and starts the game; a newer Setup updates in place and keeps saves. The shortcuts start
`WildreachUpdater.exe`, which installs any newer GitHub release by itself before starting the game (the main menu
offers **Update now** too), so players only download Setup once. It isn't code-signed, so Windows may show "Windows
protected your PC": More info, then Run anyway. Everyone runs the game, types a name, picks a
Male or Female body and Fire or Frost. One person clicks **Host** (their PC is the server; over the internet they forward UDP 7777
to their PC). Everyone else types the host's IP and clicks **Join**. Saves live on the host
(`Wildreach\Saved\ServerDB`). F10 goes back to the menu.

A packaged **dedicated server** needs Unreal built from source: `Tools\build_engine.ps1` (several hours,
~200 GB; log `C:\Dev\UE5Source-build.log`). Until then the host plays and hosts at once.

**Releasing an update:** bump `ProjectVersion` in `Config/DefaultGame.ini` (e.g. 0.2.1), run `Tools\package.ps1` and
`Tools\make_installer.ps1`, then publish a GitHub release tagged `v0.2.1` with `Wildreach-Setup.exe` attached
(`gh release create v0.2.1 C:\Dev\WildreachBuild\Wildreach-Setup.exe --target master --latest`). Installed copies
update on their next start. Clients and hosts must be on the same version to play together.

Server settings: the default preset is `playtest` (10x XP, PvP off). Pick another with `-wrpreset=pvp_standard`
(or `pve`, `casual_coop`), or write `Saved/ServerDB/server.json` with `{"preset": "custom", "base": "pve",
"settings": {...}}` using the keys in `Data/server_presets.json`.

## Build

```
"C:\Program Files\Epic Games\UE_5.8\Engine\Build\BatchFiles\Build.bat" WildreachEditor Win64 Development -Project="C:\Dev\Wildreach\Wildreach.uproject" -WaitMutex
```

Or double-click `Wildreach.uproject` (it offers to build if binaries are missing).

## Play from the editor build

```
Tools\play.ps1 local -Clients 2   # dedicated server + 2 windowed clients
Tools\play.ps1 listen             # host-and-play
Tools\play.ps1 server             # dedicated server only (port 7777)
Tools\play.ps1 client             # join 127.0.0.1:7777
```

The default map is `/Game/Maps/L_Island`, the 4 × 4 km island. Combat testing happens on `L_CombatArena`
(`play.ps1 -Map arena`). `play.ps1 -Path frost -Name You` picks your main path and keeps your save
(`?Path=` / `?WRName=` / `?Body=f` on the join URL). The main menu only appears when the game runs on its own (`-nomenu` skips it).

Rebuild the island: `Tools\terrain\build_island.ps1 -Force`. Change the trees/rocks/caves/hazards without a rebuild:
`node Tools/terrain/dressing.mjs` (writes `Data/island_dressing.json`). Move or re-balance the wildlife without a rebuild:
`node Tools/terrain/spawns.mjs` (writes `Data/island_spawns.json`: 81 packs, every wild species in its biome; a pack
comes out when a player is within 250 m, `wildlife` in `tuning.json`).

### Controls

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| WASD / mouse | move / look |
| LMB / R | light / heavy attack |
| RMB (hold) | block; the first moment of a block is a parry |
| C | dodge roll (i-frames) |
| 1–8 | path abilities in your quick slots |
| Q / Z / X | potion / eat / drink |
| Tab | lock on |
| E | interact: stations, chests, doors, beds, crops, pens, Hearth, feed or order creatures, nests, loot bags; on a knocked-out creature, the Taming menu (food, kibble, narcotics) |
| I / P / K / B | inventory / paths (learn nodes) / life skills (perks) / build menu (also crafting by hand) |
| building (B, pick a piece) | aim where it goes: LMB place, R rotate (stairs, roofs; flips a gable), RMB cancel; the ghost is red with the reason when it won't go. Demolish (top of the menu): aim at your piece, LMB removes it for half back |
| LMB at a tree / rock / shrub | gather wood / stone / fiber (a hatchet or pick in your bag gathers more) |
| G | swap sword-and-shield for the ranged weapon (bow, crossbow, blowgun, spears, bolas) and back |
| with it out: RMB (hold) / LMB / wheel | aim over the shoulder / fire or throw at the crosshair / next ammo (stone, tranq) |
| Shift / Space / V | sprint / jump / first-third person |
| M / T | map list (bosses, caves, camps, passes: distance + direction) / chat |
| F10 | back to the main menu |

### Dev commands (console)
`WRGivePoints fire 30`, `WRAutoSpend fire 30`, `WRLearn fire fire_wall`, `WRCast 3`, `WRSpawn cinderfang 3`,
`WRSpawn vulkarn 1`, `WRBossDmgPct 30 frost`, `WRGive iron_ore 20`, `WREquip copper_sword`, `WRWeapon iron fine 6`,
`WRSkill mining 50`, `WRTameStat`, `WRTorpor 100`, `WRTameGive kibble`, `WRNarcotic`, `WRClan create Name`, `WRHazard`, `WRHeal`, `WRTeleport x y`,
`WRGather tree` (bot gathers: tree / rock / shrub / node / any / off), `WRHour 21` (jump the clock), `WRSpawnAt cinderfang X Y`, `WRCreatureHP rimeclaw 0.3`, `WRTameAll stay`, `WRSky` (log the sky), `WRWildlife` (packs out, what's near),
`WRGive hunting_bow 1`, `WRGive tranq_arrow 20`, `WRRanged 1`, `WRHold 30` (root nearby creatures), `WRClearCreatures`,
`WR.ReloadTuning` (re-read `Data/tuning.json` live). Tests can override numbers: `-wrtune=key:value,key:value`.

cindehaa/calhacks-2026.desc: A Clash Royale-style arena battler, limited only by your imagination.
cindehaa/calhacks-2026.readme:
# Artifice

A real-time, two-player arena battler where your deck is whatever you can describe. Point at the arena, say what the troop is, and AI turns your words into a fighting unit with stats, quirks, a price and artwork. Say something that isn't a creature and it becomes a spell.

Built at Cal Hacks 13.0 (Oct 23–25, 2026) with Claude, Cartesia and SpacetimeDB.

## Project notes

- [meta/SPEC.md](meta/SPEC.md): the game spec (v2)
- [meta/PROGRESS.md](meta/PROGRESS.md): what's done, what's next, and the decisions log
- [meta/aesthetics.md](meta/aesthetics.md): the aesthetic vision (warmth and frost): palette, music, sound, art
- [meta/LAUNCH.md](meta/LAUNCH.md): launch plan: getting people playing, filming the montage, posting on X

## Layout

| Path | What |
|---|---|
| `shared/` | Plain TypeScript used everywhere: `sim.ts` (the combat `step()`), `troop.ts` (stat schema, clamps, `price()`), `anchors.ts` (the 15 reference troops: 10 plain, 5 with quirks), `spell.ts` (the 12 spell effects), `arena.ts` (board and match constants), `prompt.ts` (the troop-designer prompt). |
| `server/` | SpacetimeDB module: rooms, deploys, and the 20 Hz tick that runs `step()`. |
| `client/` | Vite + TypeScript browser game: lobby, 3D arena (Three.js), MediaPipe hand tracking, touch, keyboard / mouse / text input, Cartesia STT, the Pavilion. |
| `api/` | Key proxy: one Vercel function per route, with the shared code in `api/_lib/` and a local server in `api/_dev.ts`. `POST /api/troop` turns a description into a priced troop with Claude, `POST /api/voice-token` mints a 60 s Cartesia token for the browser's sockets, `POST /api/sprite` draws a troop with fal and serves it at `/api/sprite/<id>.png`, `/api/pose` draws its attack-pose frame (both kept in `.cache/` locally, Vercel Blob when deployed). |
| `sim/` | Headless balance sim: generated troops against the anchors, value per elixir. |
| `bench/` | Designer benchmark (`npm run bench`, below). |
| `meta/` | Spec, progress log and aesthetic vision. |

## Run it locally

Needs Node 22+ and the [SpacetimeDB CLI](https://spacetimedb.com/install).

`npm start` (or `./run.sh`) does all of the below in one terminal: installs dependencies if missing, creates `.env` if missing, starts and publishes SpacetimeDB (skipped if the CLI isn't installed, leaving only Play vs Bot), then runs the API and the game. Ctrl-C stops everything. To run the pieces separately:

```sh
npm install && (cd server && npm install)
cp .env.example .env          # add ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, CARTESIA_API_KEY, FAL_KEY (all optional, see below)

npm run db:start              # terminal 1: local SpacetimeDB on :3000
npm run db:publish            # once, and after every server/ change
npm run api                   # terminal 2: key proxy on :8787
npm run dev                   # terminal 3: game on http://localhost:5173
```

Every key is optional and the game still runs without it: no `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` uses the offline designer, no `CARTESIA_API_KEY` falls back to the browser's speech recognition, no `FAL_KEY` keeps the emoji placeholder tokens. `npm run api` prints which of them it found.

Open http://localhost:5173 in two tabs (each tab is its own player), create a room in one and join it from the other, or both press **Join DEMO**. From a second laptop on the same network, open `http://<this-laptop-ip>:5173`.

To run a second copy beside the first (another worktree, say), give it its own ports: `API_PORT=8790 npm run api` and `API_PORT=8790 npm run dev -- --port 5190` (Vite's `/api` proxy follows `API_PORT`), and `?db=<name>` for its own database.

After changing tables or reducers in `server/`, run `npm run db:publish` then `npm run db:generate` to refresh `client/src/module_bindings`. If a schema change is refused, `npm run db:reset` republishes and wipes the data.

To use Maincloud instead of a local server: `spacetime login`, `spacetime publish --module-path server --server maincloud <db-name> -y`, then open `http://localhost:5173/?host=https://maincloud.spacetimedb.com&db=<db-name>`.

## Deploy

The repo is linked to the Vercel project `calhacks-2026`: every push to `main` deploys to production, other branches get preview URLs. Vercel builds `client/` (`npm run build`) and serves `api/*.ts` as functions; their API keys (`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `CARTESIA_API_KEY`, `FAL_KEY`) are Vercel environment variables, not `.env`. The deployed site plays online against the Maincloud database `calhacks-arena`, so after changing `server/` run `spacetime publish --module-path server --server maincloud calhacks-arena -y`. New columns get defaults so that publish keeps the play logs; one without a default makes it ask for `--delete-data`, which wipes them.

Generated sprites and pose frames need a Vercel Blob store. Each function instance has its own temp dir, so without one a GET for `/api/sprite/<id>.png` that lands on another instance than the one that drew it 404s. Create the store once in the Vercel project (Storage → Create → Blob, public access, connected to `calhacks-2026`), which adds `BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN` to its environment variables, then redeploy so the functions pick it up. With the token set, the api writes each PNG to Blob under `sprites/<id>.png` or `poses/<id>.png` and serves it from there at the same short `/api/...` URL; without it (local dev) art stays in `.cache/` as before (`api/_lib/art_store.ts`).

The same store keeps gameplay recordings. dreamdreams77/Echoes-.readme:
# Echoes of the Forgotten Kingdom

A browser-based 3D stealth/action adventure built with three.js. No build step: open `index.html`, or serve the repo root (for example with GitHub Pages) and play.

Controls and goals are in the in-game **How to play** screen. Press **X** for the Echo Burst once the violet meter is full.

Everything (three.js, post-processing, font) is bundled in `lib/`, so the game runs fully offline. When served over http(s) it also registers a service worker and can be installed as an app.

withmuzic/sattc-league.readme:
# SATTC Team League

Standings, schedule, results and finals bracket for the San Antonio Table Tennis Club Team League.

Live page: https://withmuzic.github.io/sattc-league/

## Files
- `index.html`, `style.css`, `app.js` — the dashboard (no build step)
- `data.js` — league data: teams, schedule, game scores. **Currently sample data.**

## Scoring
1 point per game won + 2 bonus for winning the matchup (5-0 = 7/0, 4-1 = 6/1, 3-2 = 5/2).
Tiebreakers: head-to-head, matchup wins, sets won minus sets lost.

Points and standings are computed in the browser from the game scores in `data.js`.

## Results from Google Forms
Players submit results through a Google Form; league managers tick **Approved** in the Google Sheet,
and the dashboard reads approved results from an Apps Script web app (`config.js` → `DATA_URL`).
Setup: [google-apps-script/SETUP.md](google-apps-script/SETUP.md) · script: [google-apps-script/Code.gs](google-apps-script/Code.gs)
